title: Memory corruption in FileSystem in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially…
description: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in the FileSystem component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code within the sandbox by delivering a crafted HTML page. The issue is classified with high severity by the Chromium security team.
